title: bidens calva
intro: Bidens calva, commonly known as the bareseed beggarticks, is a flowering plant species belonging to the aster family. It has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and digestive problems. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and exhibit potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Bidens calva include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
